analyst_view.overall: Nordsjaelland (25th, 2 pts) host Panathinaikos (2nd, 9 pts from 3 wins): the Danes need a win to climb into the top 24, while a win would put Panathinaikos on 12 points, close to a top-eight place. Nordsjaelland hammered Copenhagen 5-0 on Sunday and have been scoring freely, form the numbers barely see because Danish league stats are not in the model, though they have not won their last three home games (0-0 Odense, 2-2 CSKA, 2-3 Midtjylland) on their artificial pitch. Panathinaikos, under Jacob Neestrup, lost Santino Andino to a torn ACL (counted, as are Ounahi and Ingason), and centre-back Stefan de Vrij has a badly swollen left wrist and was still undecided on Tuesday, with Palmer-Brown or Katris the options; left-back Salah-Eddine was tested for a respiratory infection. Austrian referee Julian Weinberger is named, and the numbers already add about 10% to cards for his record.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, split 1.6 to 1.2, already taking off Andino, Ounahi and Ingason for Panathinaikos. I lean a little higher: de Vrij and Salah-Eddine are doubts in Panathinaikos' back line, which the numbers can't see, and Nordsjaelland's 5-0 over Copenhagen shows league scoring the model doesn't track. +5% gives about 2.8 goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, split evenly. Both sides like the ball and the numbers already reflect their corner records; losing Andino, a winger, may cut Panathinaikos' wide play a little, but that is already part of his counted absence, so I stay at about 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.1 cards, already raised about 10% for Panathinaikos' recent bookings and 9.5% for referee Weinberger's record. A reshuffled Panathinaikos defence may have to foul more against Nordsjaelland's quick attack, but that is a guess on top of a figure that is already high, so I stay at about 5.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.0 shots, a little below a usual game and already raised 5% for Nordsjaelland's recent volume. Nordsjaelland's home attack should push that up, but a Panathinaikos side keeping the ball on an unfamiliar artificial surface can slow the game, so I stay at about 26.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target, already nudged up for both sides' recent accuracy. Nordsjaelland's sharp finishing in the league and a Panathinaikos back line that may be missing de Vrij, neither of which the numbers can see, point slightly higher: +3% gives about 9.9.
